items.title: Music stars pay tribute to John Farnham in special concert

children.content: Celine Dion sang from a stage in Paris, apologising to fans in attendance for a scheduling conflict, before launching into You're The Voice and bringing the crowd at Melbourne's Rod Laver Arena to its feet.
Jessica Mauboy, John Stevens, Jack Jones, Mahalia Barnes and Human Nature opened the show before other stars including Jimmy Barnes and Keith Urban took to the stage.
The sold-out show last night was held to raise funds for Head and Neck Cancer Australia, following John Farnham's own health battle in 2022.
